name: Kel Dor
description: Kel Dors were a sentient species native to the planet Dorin. In order to survive oxygen-rich environments, they wore specialized breath masks that covered their eyes and nostrils. Jedi Master Plo Koon was a Kel Dor who served on the Jedi Council in the last years of the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic. Bo Keevil was also a member of the species, who served as a pilot in Ace Squadron.

data.name: Kel Dor
data.distinctions: Rebreathers to survive in oxygen environments
